$comment: Declarative mode registry for Scrutinizer. Aesthetic modes are functional test cases for the LGN→V1→V4 pipeline. See docs/developers_guide.md for adding new modes.

highkey.label: High-Key Ghosting (Default)
highkey.description: Simulates peripheral bandwidth filtering with rod-like desaturation, Eigengrau tinting, and chromatic aberration. The default mode for usability research.

biological.label: Biological (Purkinje Darkening)
biological.description: Rigorous simulation of rod vision: red objects fade to black shadows (Purkinje shift), luminance drops significantly. More accurate but less usable.

frosted.label: Frosted Glass (iOS)
frosted.description: Low-contrast, milky aesthetic simulating cataracts or foggy conditions. Uses MIP-based pooling without aggressive color shifts.

blueprint.label: Blueprint (ARIA Wireframe)
blueprint.description: Reverse-engineers wireframes from live web pages by combining ARIA roles, congestion, saliency, and DOM structure. Shows typed annotations (buttons, inputs, headings, nav) as color-coded bounding boxes on a blueprint background. Fovea shows original content; periphery transitions to full wireframe.
blueprint.architectural_purpose: ARIA-typed wireframe visualization — structure map alpha channel encodes role IDs (0–12), shader renders color-coded bounding boxes

citations.technique: ARIA role classification + Sobel edge detection on structure map
citations.design_basis: WAI-ARIA semantic roles, Gestalt grouping principles

minecraft.label: Minecraft (Block Pooling)
minecraft.description: Blocks sized to CMF MIP level at each eccentricity (4-64px), fovea-relative grid, channel-independent neighbor color averaging in Oklab. RG boundaries merge between blocks while YV boundaries stay sharper — the same castleCSF pooling rates, visible as discrete geometry.
minecraft.architectural_purpose: Demonstrates customizing the baseline simulation — same CMF math, visible as block geometry

citations.technique: CMF-driven block quantization with Oklab neighbor averaging
citations.design_basis: Cortical magnification (Schwartz 1980), castleCSF chromatic pooling rates

minecraft_eyeball.label: Minecraft Eyeball (Polar Pooling)
minecraft_eyeball.description: Radial variant of Minecraft: wedge-shaped polar sectors sized by CMF, emanating from gaze. Radially elongated ~2:1 matching TTM pooling regions. Same Oklab chromatic decay as Minecraft.
minecraft_eyeball.architectural_purpose: Polar pooling regions visible as wedge geometry — TTM pooling made tangible

citations.technique: CMF-driven polar sector quantization with Oklab neighbor averaging
citations.biological_basis: Rosenholtz TTM pooling regions, Toet & Levi (1992) radial elongation

drunken_reading.label: Drunken Reading
drunken_reading.description: Fluid wave-based distortion simulating temporary visual impairments or disorienting states. Bypasses LGN structure masking for full ungated distortion.
drunken_reading.architectural_purpose: Stress-test for bypassing LGN gating without breaking pipeline

log_polar_mip.label: Log-Polar MIP — Color Only (Blauch 2026)
log_polar_mip.description: Cortical magnification from Blauch, Konkle & Alvarez (2026): mipLevel = maxMip × [ln(r+a) - ln(a)] / [ln(r_max+a) - ln(a)]. a=2.78°, r_max derived from screen geometry. Spatial resolution falloff only — no DoG bands, no crowding distortion. Gaussian color decay is Scrutinizer's own addition.
log_polar_mip.architectural_purpose: FOVI CMF as standalone MIP-sampling mode, orthogonal to Scrutinizer DoG/saliency pipeline

legacy_v16.label: Legacy v1.6 (Comparison)
legacy_v16.description: Frozen v1.6 pipeline snapshot for A/B comparison. Linear MIP scaling (normalizedEcc * 2.5), hand-tuned DoG band cutoffs. No CMF logarithmic scaling.
legacy_v16.architectural_purpose: Frozen v1.6 baseline for A/B dogfooding against CMF-enhanced v1.7

citations.technique: Linear MIP scaling with DoG band decomposition

congestion_pooling.label: Congestion-Gated Pooling
congestion_pooling.description: Increases peripheral pooling in high-congestion regions. Tests the prediction from Rosenholtz (2007, 2012) that visual clutter and peripheral crowding are manifestations of the same summary statistic computation. High-congestion areas get stronger MIP pooling, low-congestion areas retain more detail.
congestion_pooling.architectural_purpose: Hypothesis test: does congestion-gated pooling produce perceptually accurate peripheral simulation?

citations.biological_basis: Rosenholtz et al. (2007) clutter + Rosenholtz et al. (2012) peripheral pooling

compute_mongrel.label: Peripheral Texture Synthesis (Tier 2.5)
compute_mongrel.description: WebGPU compute shader synthesizes metamer textures matching per-tile summary statistics (mean/variance luminance, orientation energy). Implements Rosenholtz (2012) mongrel theory via oriented noise synthesis. Requires WebGPU; auto-falls back to Tier 1.6 if unavailable.
compute_mongrel.architectural_purpose: Tier 2.5: WebGPU compute mongrel synthesis — real-time summary statistics + oriented noise replacement

citations.biological_basis: Pooling regions scale with eccentricity via CMF (Schwartz 1980, FOVI 2026)

fovi_isotropic.label: FOVI Cortical Grid (Blauch)
fovi_isotropic.description: Sector-parameterized displacement derived from Blauch, Alvarez & Konkle (2026). Noise frequency and scramble cell size scale with cortical sector extent (w = log(r + a)). Sector geometry drives transition rate, not rendering mechanism. 12px cell cap prevents grid artifacts.
fovi_isotropic.architectural_purpose: FOVI isotropic sampling grid — cells are square in cortical space, ring boundaries derived from CMF, not ad-hoc geometry

citations.technique: Isotropic cortical sampling with CMF-derived ring spacing and matched spoke counts
citations.biological_basis: Blauch, Alvarez & Konkle (2026), arxiv:2602.03766 — FOVI sensing stage

pyramid_mongrel.label: Pyramid Mongrel (Tier 2.75)
pyramid_mongrel.description: Multi-scale Laplacian pyramid decomposition + cross-scale magnitude correlation matching. Tier 2.75: pyramid synthesis replaces Tier 2.5 oriented noise as the compute texture, composited with standard V1 displacement + MIP blur pipeline.
pyramid_mongrel.architectural_purpose: Tier 2.75+: Hybrid — CMF sector pooling (Tier 3 geometry) with V1 displacement + MIP blur pipeline (Tier 2.75 compositing). Sectors scale pooling regions with eccentricity; displacement provides spatial destruction.

citations.technique: Laplacian pyramid + cross-scale magnitude correlation (Portilla & Simoncelli 2000, Walton 2021)
citations.biological_basis: Pooling regions scale with eccentricity via CMF (Schwartz 1980, FOVI 2026)

tier3_synthesis.label: TTM Cortical Pooling (Tier 3 — research)
tier3_synthesis.description: Aspirational pure summary-statistic pooling via eccentricity-scaled sectors. RESEARCH MODE — artifacts expected and not RFV-safe. Requires WebGPU storage-buffer ≥9 (default cap is 8). On hardware below the cap, createBindGroupLayout fails silently and peripheral.frag falls back to sampleDoGReconstructed/sampleMIPPooled — i.e. acuity_loss behavior under a cortical_pooling label. See docs/next-steps-2026-04.md for the 2026-04-17 discovery and the acuity_loss / cortical_pooling honesty split.
tier3_synthesis.architectural_purpose: Tier 3: Pure pooling-based peripheral rendering — eccentricity-scaled sectors destroy text identity via mean pooling, cross-scale correlation preserves texture structure. No displacement.

citations.technique: TTM summary statistics within eccentricity-scaled pooling regions (Rosenholtz 2012, Portilla & Simoncelli 2000)

text_baseline_m16.label: Text Baseline (Pre-DOM-Aware)
text_baseline_m16.description: Frozen snapshot of the pre-DOM-aware pipeline. Clone of High-Key (mode 0) preserved as a comparison arm for Wallis-analogue 2IFC psychophysics validation of the incoming DOM-aware perception path. Do not modify pipeline without updating docs/dom-aware-perception-plan.md.
text_baseline_m16.architectural_purpose: Baseline arm for DOM-aware perception path. Preserves current-generation peripheral rendering for 2IFC comparison against the new path. Expected to be byte-identical to mode 0 until intentional divergence.

structural_chrome_suppression.label: Structural Chrome Suppression (V1 length-tuning)
structural_chrome_suppression.description: Mode 14 (Pyramid Mongrel) baseline + V1 length-tuning / end-stopping enabled. Probes along the local edge tangent; long edges (page-tall sidebars, table column rules, dividers) get sigmoid-suppressed in the oriented-DoG orientBonus. Short edges (word baselines, button labels) unaffected. Goal: reduce visual noise from structural chrome in real web layouts. Probe span scales with CMF MIP level so 'long' means 'long relative to local pooling region' at every eccentricity. See docs/specs/length_tuned_edge_suppression.md.
structural_chrome_suppression.architectural_purpose: First research mode for V1 length-tuning. Comparison arm vs mode 14 quantifies how much of the current peripheral saliency budget is being spent on structural-chrome edges. If validation passes (CBM 2002 curve replication + visual A/B on real web pages), parameters graduate into default modes in a future release.

citations.technique: V1 hypercomplex cell endzone inhibition + iso-orientation surround suppression
citations.biological_basis: Hubel & Wiesel 1965 hypercomplex cells; Knierim & Van Essen 1992 surround orientation tuning; Cavanaugh, Bair & Movshon 2002 quantitative length-tuning curves; Field, Hayes & Hess 1993 V2/V4 contour integration coexists at higher levels

dom_aware_text.label: DOM-Aware Text (Procedural)
dom_aware_text.description: First DOM-aware compositor mode. Text primitives get a four-term composite: L_canonical (pixel-perfect) × identityFidelity + L_categorical (procedural x-height × stroke-frequency field) × (categoryFidelity − identityFidelity) + L_blob (mip-mean × line rhythm) × (extentPresence − categoryFidelity) + L_background (baseline pipeline) × (1 − extentPresence). Calibration computed shader-side from gaze + ppd using Strasburger/Bouma formulas. Non-text primitives fall through to baseline unchanged. See docs/dom-aware-perception-plan.md.
dom_aware_text.architectural_purpose: First visible DOM-aware compositor mode. Validates procedural L_categorical against the Wallis-analogue 2IFC observer in Stage 9. Inherits mode 15 pipeline (TTM Tier 3) as L_background so non-text regions pool exactly as mongrel.

citations.technique: Procedural compositor (Majaj et al. 2002 letter-channel SF), calibration via Strasburger 2011 / Bouma 1970 / Pelli & Tillman 2008
citations.biological_basis: Recurrent top-down lexical priors gate peripheral pooling (McClelland & Rumelhart 1981; Dehaene & Cohen 2011)

0.description: Fluid, continuous distortion using animated simplex noise

1.description: Slow sine wave distortion approximating mongrel texture theory

2.description: No geometric distortion - pass UV unchanged

3.label: Pixelate (Saliency-Guided)
3.description: Blocky quantization with saliency-driven variable block sizes

4.description: Fovea-relative polar sector quantization with CMF-driven ring spacing

5.name: cortical_isotropic
5.label: Cortical Isotropic (FOVI)
5.description: FOVI-derived isotropic sector snapping — ring boundaries from uniform cortical sampling, spoke count matched for isotropy
